title: Bank-Payer Points on Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Arrangement Deposits
content:
**Cashier guidance.** Bank-payer points are taken off the deposit percentage of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility arrangement deposit according to how the latest patient-payment entry on the account was made:

| Method of the latest patient-payment entry | Points taken off |
|---|---|
| ACH bank transfer | 1 |
| check | 0.5 |
| any other method (card, HSA or FSA card) | 0 |

The method is read from the latest patient-payment entry on the coverage account's ledger; earlier entries are not read. The points lower the deposit percentage itself, applied once.

**Cases (hypothetical).** The patient's last payment was a check: 0.5 points off. The last payment was by card, although earlier ones were ACH transfers: none off.
